symbolic.source_history: Piecewise constant emitter powers integrate exactly; the shared material debit and ray credit use the identical history integral.
symbolic.limitation: A source/transport coupling API and frozen-metric radiation stress; the material EOS and Einstein evolution are not advanced here.

scope: No material state or Einstein time advance. History modulation is a software/control input, not a new native nuclear trajectory.
